description: This file is a PHP class definition for the Startup Tax Controller in the OpenCart framework. It initializes tax-related settings and addresses during the startup process of the catalog module.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: A controller class responsible for initializing the tax module during application startup by setting addresses based on session data or configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the tax system with addresses from session data or default configuration during startup.
